title: 431 panelist judgment — one (candidate + envelope) x parameter
_authority: build_log/431_partB_measurement_instruction.md (v3.2.1, RATIFIED 2026-07-19, committed fa61660) §5; contract from Part A §4.1
_notes: additionalProperties:false at every level is the structural enforcement (mirrors the 423C elicitation schema): a verdict, risk, materiality, or provision-id field fails validation rather than being silently accepted.
Enums are CLOSED. Where a value outside the set is genuinely needed, 'other' + the matching free-text description field is the only escape hatch (Part A §4.1) — never an open list.
'not_applicable' is schema-fixed for parameters where a dimension is not a meaningful attribute. It is NOT 'none' and NOT 'unclear'.

field_support maps each substantive semantic field to the citation ids that ground it. Empty support, or support whose quotes do not resolve, invalidates that field for that evaluator (Part A §4.5) — it is not a confidence reduction.

candidate_span_id.description: The opaque candidate identifier supplied in the payload. Echo it back unchanged.

context_envelope_id.description: The opaque envelope identifier supplied in the payload. Echo it back unchanged.

parameter_family_relevance.description: Is this passage genuinely evidence bearing on the stated parameter family? This is an INCLUSION judgment about topical relevance. It is NOT a judgment about whether the passage matches any required charge basis, and NOT a judgment about whether it is sufficient.

candidate_support_state.description: Does the supplied text (candidate + envelope ONLY) show that the contractual mechanism named by the parameter family operates in this document? If the establishing language could lie outside the supplied text, answer insufficient_context. Never infer document-wide absence from the bounded text you were given.

text_role.description: The drafting role of the candidate passage. operative_term = language that itself creates, imposes, or fixes an obligation, right, or quantity. definition = language that assigns a meaning to a defined term. narrative = language that describes, explains, or comments on other provisions rather than itself creating or fixing anything. unclear = cannot be determined from the supplied text.

value_completeness.description: Does the candidate passage itself carry the numeric quantity for this parameter family? self_contained = the quantity appears in the candidate text itself. cross_reference_only = the candidate directs the reader elsewhere for the quantity rather than stating it. no_value = neither a quantity nor a direction to one. unclear = cannot be determined.

charge_basis_components.description: Which charge base(s) the candidate establishes the proportion is taken against. Use the array form for share-type parameters. Use the string 'not_applicable' where the payload states this dimension does not apply to the parameter family. 'none' means no basis was found; 'unclear' means it could not be determined. These three are distinct and must not be merged.

other_basis_description.description: Required only when charge_basis_components includes 'other'. Free text naming the basis actually found.

charge_scope.description: The denominator/scope the proportion is measured against, where the parameter family has one.

other_scope_description.description: Required only when charge_scope is 'other'. Free text naming the scope actually found.

candidate_citations.description: Verbatim quotes taken from the CANDIDATE text only. Each quote must appear character-for-character in the candidate text.

context_citations.description: Verbatim quotes taken from the CONTEXT text only. Each quote must appear character-for-character in the context text.

field_support.description: For each substantive semantic field, the citation ids that ground your judgment on THAT field. A field you assert substantively must list at least one citation id here. If you cannot ground a field in a quote, answer 'unclear' for that field rather than asserting it without support.

reason.description: One to three sentences. Ground each field you assert in the quotes you cited.

citation_id.description: A short identifier unique within this response, e.g. cc1, xc1. Referenced from field_support.

quote.description: Verbatim text copied exactly from the supplied passage. Do not paraphrase, normalize, reformat, or elide with ellipses.
